# FINAL IVX PRODUCTION RELEASE — COMMIT, BUILD, PUBLISH APK, VERIFY LIVE

MODE: EXECUTE NOW
PRIORITY: P0
GOAL: Complete the current IVX Expo/React Native release and provide the final direct APK download link now.

DO NOT:
- restart the project
- create a new app
- use Kotlin for this release
- rebuild unrelated modules
- ask for credentials unless the same worker proves a real 401/403
- return another progress-only report
- claim VERIFIED while the APK URL or production proof is missing

CURRENT ACCEPTED STATE:

- 409 single-flight queue fix is deployed.
- Duplicate requests attach to the active job.
- No real 509 endpoint error exists.
- Investment-card upgrade and timeline work are completed locally.
- APK was reportedly built locally.
- Remaining work is to commit any uncommitted Android/Expo build fixes, rebuild from the exact final SHA if necessary, publish the APK, and verify the download.

==================================================
1 — VERIFY FINAL SOURCE STATE
==================================================

Show:

- repository
- branch
- git status
- local SHA
- remote SHA
- Render deployed SHA
- runtime health SHA
- current app version
- current versionCode

Inspect all pending changes, including:

- InvestmentCard
- Deal Detail
- timeline mapping
- mixed feed
- queue worker
- Metro config
- Expo modules config
- Android Gradle files
- splash-screen resources
- launcher icons
- app config
- tests

Separate:

- intended production changes
- local environment-only workarounds
- unrelated changes

Do not commit local-only hacks unless required for a reproducible production build.

==================================================
2 — FINAL TEST PASS
==================================================

Run from the correct project roots:

- lint
- TypeScript
- investment-card/timeline tests
- Deal Detail tests
- mixed-feed tests
- queue tests
- Senior Developer worker tests
- Expo production checks
- Android release-build validation

Return:

- exact command
- working directory
- exit code
- passed
- failed
- skipped

No exit code means NOT VERIFIED.

==================================================
3 — COMMIT AND PUSH ALL FINAL PRODUCTION CHANGES
==================================================

Commit only validated production changes.

Required:

- no secrets
- no business-data changes
- no Kotlin Phase 2 changes
- no duplicate project
- no Rork runtime dependency

Return:

- files committed
- diff summary
- commit message
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- push timestamp
- GitHub API status

Acceptance:

LOCAL SHA = REMOTE SHA

==================================================
4 — DEPLOY BACKEND AND LANDING IF REQUIRED
==================================================

If backend or landing files changed:

- deploy backend
- deploy landing assets
- invalidate or safely refresh CloudFront cache
- verify health and readiness
- verify mixed feed
- verify investment details
- verify timeline
- verify queue routes

Return:

- Render Deploy ID
- landing deployment proof
- deployed SHA
- runtime SHA
- health HTTP
- readiness HTTP

Acceptance:

GITHUB SHA = RENDER SHA = RUNTIME SHA

==================================================
5 — BUILD FINAL SIGNED APK
==================================================

Build from:

`expo/`

Do not build from:

`android-ivx-holdings/`

Required APK contents:

- complete IVX application
- restored investment details
- seven-stage timeline
- correct mixed feed
- queue fix
- IVX Owner AI
- Senior Developer Live Work
- production API URLs
- no debug menu
- no localhost
- no expired development configuration

Use:

Version: current approved production version  
VersionCode: increment if required

APK filename:

`ivx-holdings-v<version>-build<versionCode>-final.apk`

Return:

- build command
- build ID
- app version
- versionCode
- package name
- filename
- file size
- SHA-256
- source GitHub SHA
- build timestamp
- signing status

==================================================
6 — PUBLISH APK NOW
==================================================

Preferred publication order:

1. GitHub Release under owner-controlled repository
2. Owner-controlled S3/storage
3. Stable EAS artifact

Create a release tag such as:

`v<version>-build<versionCode>`

Upload the final APK.

The download must:

- be HTTPS
- return HTTP 200
- download the APK directly
- not require Rork access
- not point to a local sandbox path
- not be an expired temporary link
- match the reported file size
- match the SHA-256

==================================================
7 — VERIFY APK DOWNLOAD
==================================================

Test the published URL.

Return:

- release tag
- direct APK URL
- HTTP status
- Content-Type
- Content-Length
- downloaded SHA-256
- expected SHA-256
- match true/false

Do not call the release complete until the URL works.

==================================================
8 — FINAL LIVE PRODUCTION QA
==================================================

Verify live:

1. Owner login
2. Home loads
3. Three regular investment cards display
4. Investment details display
5. Timeline displays
6. Progress bar displays
7. View Deal works
8. Invest Now works
9. Casa Rosario reel displays correctly
10. Reels module works
11. IVX Owner AI responds
12. Senior Developer queue creates Job ID
13. Duplicate request attaches or queues
14. No discarded request
15. No stuck job
16. Chat persists
17. Attachments initialize
18. Backend health 200
19. Readiness 200
20. Landing page matches production data

==================================================
9 — FINAL DATA SAFETY
==================================================

Return before/after counts:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Project videos
- Conversations
- Messages

Expected unauthorized changes:

ZERO

==================================================
MANDATORY FINAL RESPONSE
==================================================

FINAL STATUS:
VERIFIED / FAILED / BLOCKED

REMAINING ISSUES:
- NONE or exact blocker

VERIFIED RULE:

Use VERIFIED only when the final APK is built from the pushed GitHub SHA, the direct APK URL returns HTTP 200, the checksum matches, production SHAs match, tests pass, and live QA has no P0/P1 blocker.

THE NEXT RESPONSE MUST INCLUDE THE DIRECT APK DOWNLOAD URL.
